issues: Covers rose to 2,432, up 803 (49.29%) week on week.
Spend per head fell to £14.74, down £4.38 (22.90%).
Sales were £41,316.59, up £5,217.51 (14.45%) week on week (the report shows the movement with a minus sign) and £8,016.59 (24.07%) ahead of target.
It was the first £40k week since April, achieved with about 1,000 more covers than the April week.
Operational food cost was 27% (£11,474.07), down from about £12.5k the week before.
Inka Cheung said she is comfortable with food cost of 23% to 24% if it buys excellent service and returning customers, and will check par levels and voucher redemptions with Sophie.
The site keeps running out: no Diet Coke over the weekend, steak stopped at 8pm each night and sous vide chicken running short, and storage would be a problem for £60k to £70k weeks.
At the BOH meeting the £5 ramen was selling about 150 a day, around £7.5k of lost revenue and £13k of discounted sales, leaving the team exhausted.
Vanilla ice cream, ramen noodles and takoyaki ran out despite daily top-ups, and eggs had to be bought from Tesco.
Labour remained high because the week was so busy, and an extra person has been rostered this week instead of calling staff in early.
Delivery was closed for a while on Monday, probably because the tablet was not charged.
Delivery errors included two katsu curries with bamboo shoots despite a request without them, one missing egg and one food safety complaint about chicken.
Some Slurp orders came through for items that were out of stock, so every version of an item must be switched off.
There were no bad Google reviews last week.
A BOH review complained of a 40 minute wait and bland grey steak tataki, which Maged disputed as service took 30 minutes at most and over 100 steaks sold without issue.
Front of house was short on Saturday and ran with three waiters instead of four.
A new FOH starter is due on Friday, a trial shift is on Wednesday and an FOH advert is out.
BOH is recruiting a part time line chef, another new KP is starting and Chester has returned to sushi.
Part time staff and an extra kitchen porter are being hired to fit student schedules of 10 to 20 hours, and Emily is reviewing a CV for a sushi chef trial.
Illness is going round the team.
Front of house standards need reiterating because of many new starters and returnees, and the last week was chaotic.
The GM and assistant have been stretched thin and doing admin from home late at night.

A cracked sewage pipe behind the wooden panelling in the men's toilets has been found as the source of the long running leak and flies; it is a maintenance job and Ross is checking Tyrone's availability.
Canopy cleaning is scheduled for 07/10.
A repair worker replaced the dishwasher pump last week.
The seafood freezer seal is faulty, and the old chest freezer may be removed.
The glass light shades have not been ordered because Ross did not have the link.

The floors, especially the bar area, are still sticky after the deep clean; Michael suggested a professional floor cleaner and a graffiti artist for the black wall, and the GM is trialling a pound shop floor cleaner first.
A team member handled a biohazard clean-up in the women's toilets on Saturday.
Drinks menus are worn and the ramen loyalty cards are too small for the table toppers, so they should sit on top of them; more XOXO material is also needed.
The site asked whether Mapal must be done on site devices by FOH and BOH; Inka confirmed it applies to FOH only and standard logins are used.
China stock is awaited and chopsticks have been ordered.
Free ramen bounce back from the app is starting, the Sunday Panthers game should make Sunday evening very busy, and the Deliveroo promotion with scratch cards started on 05/10.
Review volume is an area for improvement.
Region-wide (England): the £5 ramen offer is now limited to one per person through a backend change, announced by Amy Tang at the 06/10 KPI meeting.

Region-wide (England): the Mapal compliance app (transcribed as 'Maple') must be installed on site laptops and iPads, with photos sent to the management chat; front of house staff may no longer use personal phones for compliance on shift, while kitchen staff may use their own phones.

Region-wide (England): table toppers must carry exactly one drink menu, one XOXO drink and one ramen loyalty card, and marketing material requests go to the England group chat for Amy Tang to forward to marketing.

Region-wide (England): at the 06/10 BOH meeting Sophie asked sites to top up stock through the promotions rather than hold back for food cost limits, to monitor dashboard stock levels, and to stop borrowing stock between branches.
